tex_content.html:
Suppose that $\{ N_0,\cdots \} $ is an infinite chain of $\epsilon $-necks in $M$. Then the frontier of $U=\cup _{i=0}^\infty N_i$ is the frontier of the negative end of $N_0$.

Proof

\sketch ↗ cor:neck-distance-estimates

□

In fact, there is a geometric version of Lemma 2.
